scope: Prototype action/contract verification. Fake-provider results do not measure answer quality.

scenarios.name: missing_prerequisite
scenarios.input: 学习梯度下降；前置导数状态 unknown

scenarios.name: wrong_after_explanation
scenarios.input: 选择本次测验的错误选项
scenarios.expected: 记一次错误、example 模式、新 quiz ID

scenarios.name: repeated_success
scenarios.input: 对同一前置概念连续两次正确作答

scenarios.name: out_of_scope
scenarios.input: 这个问题与当前课程无关；另传入其他空间 concept/chat ID
scenarios.expected: clarify 或 404，不泄露其他空间

scenarios.name: multiple_documents
scenarios.input: What is gradient descent? 两份材料分别支持解释
scenarios.expected: 引用真实召回的两份文档，quote 为原文子串

scenarios.name: insufficient_evidence
scenarios.expected: 验证网页后使用，或明确 gap，不能编造证据

scenarios.name: unsuitable_material
scenarios.input: 损坏 PDF、重复文件、与已存资料冲突的文件

scenarios.name: compressed_context
scenarios.input: 多轮长历史；纠正：之后统一用列向量表示输入。
scenarios.expected: 最终模型输入保留空间、概念、纠正且受 token 预算限制

answer_rubric.reference_consistency: 0 incorrect / 1 partially correct / 2 correct and sufficient; human required
answer_rubric.citation_support: verify every quote occurs in actually visible evidence and supports its associated claim; human semantic check required

baseline: Same Knowledge.retrieve/settings/provider/answer generation, baseline=true omits mastery and preferences. Only answer/citation capabilities compared; no action score. Real comparison not run without DeepSeek key.
